classification.classification_note: The observed read is a stale-regex-AST access: a BAG node for capture group 3 is freed during look-behind simplification and then re-walked by the optimizer through a lingering CALL-body alias.

bug_description.normalized: Stage 01 reproduced an AddressSanitizer heap-use-after-free READ 4 in `optimize_nodes` while compiling the exact staged 20-byte mbregex witness `(())\g<3>{0}(?<=|())`. `onig_parse_tree()` materializes that string as a regex AST containing a zero-repetition quantifier around a subexpression call `\g<3>` and a look-behind `(?<=|())` whose second alternative owns capture group 3. During call tuning, the CALL node stores a direct `NODE_CALL_BODY` pointer to that group-3 BAG node. During look-behind tuning, `node_char_len()` proves the look-behind is certainly zero-length and `onig_node_reset_empty()` replaces the look-behind with an empty string, recursively freeing the old subtree including capture group 3. The vulnerable optimizer then reaches `set_optimize_info_from_tree()` and still recurses into the `{0}` quantifier body; the subsequent CALL-node optimization follows the stale `NODE_CALL_BODY` pointer into the freed BAG node, and `switch (NODE_TYPE(node))` reads the freed object, producing the observed ASan heap-use-after-free.

source.value_from: The staged `poc` is the exact 20-byte ASCII pattern `(())\g<3>{0}(?<=|())` (hex `28 28 29 29 5c 67 3c 33 3e 7b 30 7d 28 3f 3c 3d 7c 28 29 29`). `onig_parse_tree()` parses it into a tree whose vulnerability-relevant pieces are a `NODE_QUANT` with `upper == 0` around a `NODE_CALL` to capture group 3, and a look-behind `(?<=|())` whose second alternative owns capture group 3.

tainted_value_origin.description: The exact witness bytes control the AST shape that drives the bug: a zero-repeat quantifier over a subexpression call to group 3, plus a zero-length look-behind subtree that later frees that same group-3 BAG node.

root_cause.description: The optimizer still descends into the body of a `{0}` quantifier instead of treating that subtree as length 0 and stopping before any stale aliases are followed.
root_cause.note: This is the missing lifetime guard the real upstream fix adds. In the local nested `oniguruma` history, commit `56182c7ef3b98c89f0978ca44efaa1165d97f958` inserts `if (qn->upper == 0) { mml_set_min_max(&opt->len, 0, 0); break; }` immediately before this recursive call. The staged top-level `patch.diff` does not touch `oniguruma/src/regcomp.c` and is unrelated to the witnessed crash.

sink.description: ASan sink. `NODE_TYPE(node)` dereferences the freed BAG node that used to represent capture group 3.
sink.note: The saved ASan trace reports `READ of size 4` at `oniguruma/src/regcomp.c:6263:11`, address `0x60700000bd20`, 0 bytes inside the freed 72-byte region `[0x60700000bd20,0x60700000bd68)`. The same trace shows the region was allocated for a BAG node by `node_new_bag/node_new_memory/parse_bag` and freed by `tune_look_behind -> onig_node_reset_empty -> node_reset_str` before this read.

parser_admitted.description: The exact 20-byte ASCII witness passes mbstring's encoding validation and the regex-cache miss path enters `onig_new()`. The crash occurs during Oniguruma compilation before any matching/search logic runs.

fine_trace.note: Source. `onig_parse_tree()` materializes the exact witness `(())\g<3>{0}(?<=|())` into an AST that contains a `NODE_QUANT` with `upper == 0` around a `NODE_CALL` to capture group 3, and a look-behind `(?<=|())` whose second alternative defines capture group 3.

Call resolution binds the `\g<3>` CALL node to the BAG_MEMORY node for capture group 3 that was created while parsing the look-behind alternative. This stores a direct pointer alias from the CALL node to that BAG node.
When the tuner reaches the `{0}` around `\g<3>`, it records that this quantifier body is in zero repetition. That state is the reason the body should later be treated as unreachable by the optimizer.

The CALL node itself is marked `IN_ZERO_REPEAT` and its entry count is decremented under that state. Later `tune_call2()` skips quantifier bodies with `upper == 0`, so this call path is no longer treated as a live caller even though the direct `NODE_CALL_BODY` alias from step 2 remains stored on the CALL node.

For the witness look-behind `(?<=|())`, `node_char_len()` proves the body is certainly zero-length: one alternative is empty, and the other is an empty capture group. Control therefore enters the branch that replaces the entire look-behind with an empty string.

Invalidation step. `onig_node_reset_empty()` calls `node_reset_str()` on the look-behind anchor, which recursively frees the old look-behind subtree. That free includes the BAG_MEMORY node for capture group 3, so the `NODE_CALL_BODY` pointer saved in step 2 becomes dangling.

Root cause. During optimizer setup, the `NODE_QUANT` case still recurses into the body of the `{0}` quantifier instead of returning zero length immediately. The real upstream fix adds that missing `qn->upper == 0` fast path just before this line.

The `NODE_CALL` case follows the stored `NODE_CALL_BODY` alias from step 2. Because step 6 already freed capture group 3, this recursive call passes a dangling BAG-node pointer into `optimize_nodes()`.

Sink. `NODE_TYPE(node)` reads `node->u.base.node_type` from the freed BAG node passed in step 8. ASan reports `READ of size 4` at this line, inside the same 72-byte region allocated for the group-3 BAG node during parsing and freed by the look-behind reset in step 6.

allocation_context.note: The freed region is the BAG node for capture group 3 in the look-behind alternative. ASan's allocation stack is `node_new -> node_new_bag -> node_new_memory -> parse_bag`.

free_context.note: The semantic invalidation happens when `tune_look_behind()` calls `onig_node_reset_empty(node)`, which frees the old look-behind body via `node_reset_str()` and `node_free_body()`.

cross_validation.root_cause_matches_allocation_context: The freed object is the BAG node allocated for capture group 3 during parse. The root cause is later: vulnerable `optimize_nodes()` still traverses the zero-repeat quantifier and then the stale CALL-body alias after that BAG has been freed.
cross_validation.patch_resolves_note: The staged top-level `patch.diff` and metadata `fixed_commit` do not modify `oniguruma/src/regcomp.c` or `oniguruma/src/regparse.c`, so they are unrelated to the witnessed crash. The matching upstream fix is nevertheless present in the nested `oniguruma` git history as commit `56182c7ef3b98c89f0978ca44efaa1165d97f958`, which adds the missing `qn->upper == 0` early return before step 7.

format.contract: Exact staged 20-byte ASCII pattern `(())\g<3>{0}(?<=|())` and no broader class claim. This witness specifically compiles into a zero-repeat quantifier over a subexpression call to capture group 3 plus a zero-length look-behind `(?<=|())` that owns capture group 3; the crash occurs during Oniguruma optimization before any match/search executes.
